blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — Boholanos on Thursday (October 15) remembered the victims of the devastating magnitude 7.2 earthquake that struck the province 13 years ago. The powerful tremor claimed lives, destroyed homes and churches, and displaced hundreds of thousands of residents. At 8:12 a.m., the exact time the earthquake struck on October 15, 2013, survivors and residents observed a moment of silence, in memory of those who perished in the disaster. Then, church bells rang while sirens sounded for 33 seconds as part of the commemoration. The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) and disaster risk reduction management offices in the province […]...
